# factory-fetch

Fetch one runtime artifact and verify its sha256. Source customization lives here.

An MCP engine. forge resolves it by URI and calls a tool over stdio.

```yaml
engine: forge://github.com/alexandremahdhaoui/forge-factory/cmd/factory-fetch@v0.1.0
```

## Tools

| Tool | Does | Input | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fetch` | Bring one artifact's bytes to a local path, hash-verified. The spec's rewrite rules retarget url prefixes at a mirror or an internal artifact store. | `FetchInput` | `FetchOutput` |

## Running it by hand

```sh
go run ./cmd/factory-fetch --mcp
```

It speaks JSON-RPC on stdin and stdout. Logs go to stderr, because
anything else corrupts the stream.
